name: biashara-os
description: BiasharaOS — local business management app for Kenyan dukas and kiosks (sales, stock, customers, debts, M-PESA, reports).

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:libs && npm run typecheck --workspace=@workspace/api-server --workspace=@workspace/biashara-os --if-present
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build --workspace=@workspace/db --workspace=@workspace/api-server --workspace=@workspace/biashara-os --if-present
